name: What is the process for installing non-glare lighting upgrades?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing non-glare lighting upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing non-glare lighting upgrades typically begins with an initial consultation and site assessment by our team. We discuss your goals, inspect existing electrical infrastructure, and recommend suitable non-glare solutions. After finalizing the design and receiving your approval, our licensed electricians will safely remove old fixtures, perform any necessary wiring modifications or additions, and install the new non-glare lighting. This often involves integrating dimmers, smart controls, or specialized mounting hardware. We then test the system to ensure optimal performance and address any final adjustments. The duration depends on the project's complexity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves a consultation, site assessment, design finalization, electrical work by licensed professionals, and testing to ensure optimal performance of the new non-glare lighting system.
